preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) <= 2 * 10**5])
preconditions.description: Each test case has a number of vertices n between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(b) == n and all(1 <= b_i <= n for b_i in b) for b in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the ancestor array b has exactly n integers, each between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(p) == n and all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p) and len(set(p)) == n for p in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the permutation p has exactly n distinct integers, each between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(b_i == i or (b_i != i and b_i in range(1, n + 1)) for b in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()] for i, b_i in enumerate(b, 1))
preconditions.description: For each vertex i, b_i is either i (root) or another vertex in the tree.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output) == n for output in [line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either a list of n integers (edge weights) or -1.

postconditions.expression: all(w_i == 0 or 1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for w_i in [int(w) for w in line.strip().split()]) or line.strip() == '-1' for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()
postconditions.description: Each edge weight w_i is either 0 (root) or between 1 and 10^9 inclusive, or the output is -1.

postconditions.expression: all(dist[p_i] < dist[p_{i+1}] for i in range(n - 1)) if line.strip() != '-1' else True for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit() for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()] for p in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()] for dist in [compute_distances(line.strip().split(), b) for b in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()]]
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, the distances from the root to vertices must satisfy dist[p_i] < dist[p_{i+1}] for all i from 1 to n-1, where dist is computed using the edge weights in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(dist[p_i] != dist[p_j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n)) if line.strip() != '-1' else True for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit() for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()] for p in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()] for dist in [compute_distances(line.strip().split(), b) for b in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()]]
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, all distances from the root to vertices must be distinct.
